description:
Explore and visualize the San Francisco zoning dataset using Jupyter Lab.

Task: Using Jupyter Lab, load and analyze the zoning data from the San Francisco UrbanSim dataset to understand development regulations.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Open the Jupyter notebook at /home/ga/urbansim_projects/notebooks/zoning_exploration.ipynb
- Load the 'zoning' table from /home/ga/urbansim_projects/data/sanfran_public.h5
- Display the first 10 rows and the column data types
- Calculate and display summary statistics for all numeric zoning columns (max_far, max_height, coverage, etc.)
- Count the number of zoning districts by name and display the top 10 most common (use the 'name' column)
- Create a histogram of the max_far (maximum floor area ratio) distribution and save it to /home/ga/urbansim_projects/output/zoning_far_histogram.png
- Save a summary CSV with columns: column_name, mean, std, min, max to /home/ga/urbansim_projects/output/zoning_summary.csv

The notebook should be executed with all cells run and outputs visible.
